description: Rajasthan vs Madhya Pradesh, five rounds of official data. Final score: Madhya Pradesh 3, Rajasthan 2.

MBBS seats per lakh people: Rajasthan 7.2, Madhya Pradesh 5.5 (Rajasthan ahead; seats 2024-25 · population 2024 · higher is better)
Forest cover: Rajasthan 4.8%, Madhya Pradesh 25.0% (Madhya Pradesh ahead; % of geographical area · ISFR 2023 · higher is better)
Colleges per lakh aged 18-23: Rajasthan 47.0, Madhya Pradesh 28.0 (Rajasthan ahead; per lakh aged 18-23 · 2023-24 · higher is better)
Tigers per 10,000 sq km: Rajasthan 2.6, Madhya Pradesh 25.5 (Madhya Pradesh ahead; 2022 estimate · higher is better)
Monuments per 10,000 sq km: Rajasthan 4.7, Madhya Pradesh 9.4 (Madhya Pradesh ahead; centrally protected · ASI, 2025 · higher is better)

Closing map: Forest cover share, every state (Madhya Pradesh 25 · Rajasthan 4.8 · India 21.8%). Forest cover as share of each state's area, ISFR 2023. Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh: no separate share printed. Both states outlined.
